message.reasoning:
We need to extract explicit facts.

Text: "Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles and Fundamental Duties of India

The Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles of State Policy and Fundamental Duties are sections of the Constitution of India that prescribe the fundamental obligations of the states to its citizens and the duties and the rights of the citizens to the State. These sections comprise a constitutional bill of rights for government policy - making and the behaviour and conduct of citizens. These sections are considered vital elements of the constitution, which was developed between 1947 and 1949 by the Constituent assembly of India."

We need to produce triplets.

Identify entities: Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles of State Policy, Fundamental Duties (maybe treat each as separate). Also "Constitution of India". "states" (maybe entity type "state (government)"), "citizens". "Constituent assembly of India". Also "constitutional bill of rights for government policy - making and the behaviour and conduct of citizens" maybe relation "comprise" etc.

Let's parse sentences.

Sentence 1: "The Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles of State Policy and Fundamental Duties are sections of the Constitution of India that prescribe the fundamental obligations ..."

Triplet: subject "Fundamental Rights" relation "instance of" maybe "section of" but we need "section of" relation? The phrase "are sections of the Constitution of India". So we can have three subjects each "Fundamental Rights", "Directive Principles of State Policy", "Fundamental Duties" with relation "part of" or "section of". Use "section of". So:

- ("Fundamental Rights", "section of", "Constitution of India")
- ("Directive Principles of State Policy", "section of", "Constitution of India")
- ("Fundamental Duties", "section of", "Constitution of India")

subject_type: maybe "legal concept". object_type: "legal document". Use "legal concept" and "legal document".

Next: "that prescribe the fundamental obligations of the states to its citizens and the duties and the rights of the citizens to the State."

We need to capture that these sections prescribe obligations and duties/rights. Could create triplet: subject "Fundamental Rights" relation "prescribes" object "fundamental obligations of the states to its citizens". But maybe combine? We can create separate for each section? The phrase "these sections prescribe..." So we can have subject "Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles of State Policy and Fundamental Duties" collectively. But we need separate? Could create one triplet with subject "Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles of State Policy and Fundamental Duties" as a combined string. But better separate each? The text says "The Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles of State Policy and Fundamental Duties are sections ... that prescribe ...". So each of them prescribe. So we can create three triplets with same relation "prescribes" and object "fundamental obligations of the states to its citizens". Also maybe separate for "duties and the rights of the citizens to the State". Could be two objects: "duties of the citizens to the State" and "rights of the citizens to the State". Could produce separate triplets.

Thus:

- ("Fundamental Rights", "prescribes", "fundamental obligations of the states to its citizens")
- ("Directive Principles of State Policy", "prescribes", "fundamental obligations of the states to its citizens")
- ("Fundamental Duties", "prescribes", "fundamental obligations of the states to its citizens")

Similarly for duties and rights:

- ("Fundamental Rights", "prescribes", "duties of the citizens to the State")
- ("Fundamental Rights", "prescribes", "rights of the citizens to the State")
- same for Directive Principles and Fundamental Duties? The text says "the duties and the rights of the citizens to the State" as part of what they prescribe. So each section prescribes both duties and rights. So we can create for each.

But maybe too many; but we need to extract every explicitly stated fact. So yes.

Next sentence: "These sections comprise a constitutional bill of rights for government policy - making and the behaviour and conduct of citizens."

Triplet: subject each section? "These sections comprise a constitutional bill of rights for government policy-making and the behaviour and conduct of citizens."

Relation "comprise" object "constitutional bill of rights for government policy-making and the behaviour and conduct of citizens". Could keep as one object phrase.

Thus three triplets: each section "comprise" that object.

Next: "These sections are considered vital elements of the constitution, which was developed between 1947 and 1949 by the Constituent assembly of India."

Triplet: subject each section "considered vital element of" object "constitution". Relation maybe "considered vital element of". Use "considered vital element of". So:

- ("Fundamental Rights", "considered vital element of", "Constitution of India") etc.

Also "constitution was developed between 1947 and 1949 by the Constituent assembly of India."

Triplet: subject "Constitution of India" relation "developed" object "Constitution of India"? Actually "the constitution" is the same. So we need "Constitution of India" relation "development period" maybe "point in time" qualifiers. Use relation "developed by" object "Constituent assembly of India" with qualifier point in time "1947-1949". Could also separate start and end but we can put range as string.

Thus:

- ("Constitution of India", "developed by", "Constituent Assembly of India") with qualifier point in time "1947-1949".

Also maybe "Constituent Assembly of India" type "organisation". "Constitution of India" type "legal document".

Now need subject_type and object_type.

- Fundamental Rights: legal concept
- Directive Principles of State Policy: legal concept
- Fundamental Duties: legal concept
- Constitution of India: legal document
- fundamental obligations of the states to its citizens: maybe "obligation" (type "legal concept")
- duties of the citizens to the State: "obligation" or "duty"
- rights of the citizens to the State: "right"
- constitutional bill of rights for government policy-making and the behaviour and conduct of citizens: maybe "legal concept" or "policy document". Use "legal concept".
- Constituent Assembly of India: organisation (maybe "government body").

Now qualifiers: For "developed by" we add qualifier point in time "1947-1949". Also maybe "by" is already captured as object.

No other qualifiers.

12. Fundamental Duties - prescribes - rights of the citizens to the State

13-15: each comprises constitutional bill of rights...

19. Constitution of India - developed by - Constituent Assembly of India (qualifier point in time "1947-1949")

subject_type for legal concepts: "legal concept". object_type for Constitution: "legal document". For obligations: "obligation". For duties: "duty". For rights: "right". For constitutional bill: "legal concept". For "Constituent Assembly of India": "organisation".

Now qualifiers list: only for triplet 19.
